Name: is_school
Formula: tour.tour_type == 'school' and person.is_k12 if _DF_IS_TOUR else False

Name: is_intrazonal
Formula: person.home_zone_id == tour.destination if has_destination else person.home_zone_id == tour.alt_dest

Name: coef_cost
Formula: coef_cost_low * person.is_low_income + coef_cost_med * person.is_medium_income + coef_cost_high * person.is_high_income + coef_cost_high * person.is_very_high_income

Name: _free_parking_available
Formula: tour.tour_type == 'work' and person.free_parking_at_work if _DF_IS_TOUR else False

Description: SOV Pay unavailable if toll distance = 0
Name: SOV_PAY_Available
Formula: skim.SOV_TOLL_TOLLDISTANCE[o, d, out_period] > 0 and skim.SOV_TOLL_TOLLDISTANCE[d, o, in_period] > 0

Description: HOV 2 Pay unavailable if toll distance = 0
Name: HOV2_PAY_Available
Formula: skim.HOV2_TOLL_TOLLDISTANCE[o, d, out_period] > 0 and skim.HOV2_TOLL_TOLLDISTANCE[d, o, in_period] > 0

Description: HOV 3+ Pay unavailable if toll distance = 0
Name: HOV3_PAY_Available
Formula: skim.HOV3_TOLL_TOLLDISTANCE[o, d, out_period] > 0 and skim.HOV3_TOLL_TOLLDISTANCE[d, o, in_period] > 0

Name: WalkModeAvailable
Formula: skim.SOV_FREE_DISTANCE[o, d, out_period] < 3 and skim.SOV_FREE_DISTANCE[d, o, in_period] < 3

Name: BikeModeAvailable
Formula: skim.SOV_FREE_DISTANCE[o, d, out_period] < 8 and skim.SOV_FREE_DISTANCE[d, o, in_period] < 8

Description: WLKALL transit in-vehicle time - outbound direction
Name: WalkAllTotalIVT_out
Formula: skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_LOCAL[o, d, out_period] + expr * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_XBUS[o, d, out_period] + hrt * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_HRT[o, d, out_period] + brt * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_BRT[o, d, out_period] + lrt * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_LRT[o, d, out_period] + crl * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_COMRAIL[o, d, out_period]

Description: WLKALL transit in-vehicle time - return direction
Name: WalkAllTotalIVT_ret
Formula: skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_LOCAL[d, o, in_period] + expr * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_XBUS[d, o, in_period] + hrt * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_HRT[d, o, in_period] + brt * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_BRT[d, o, in_period] + lrt * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_LRT[d, o, in_period] + crl * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_COMRAIL[d, o, in_period]

Name: WalkAllTransitAvailable
Formula: skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_LOCAL[o, d, out_period] * skim.WLK_ALLTRN_WLK_LOCAL[d, o, in_period] > 0

Description: WLKPRM transit in-vehicle time - outbound direction
Name: WalkPrmTotalIVT_out
Formula: skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_LOCAL[o, d, out_period] + expr * skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_XBUS[o, d, out_period] + hrt * skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_HRT[o, d, out_period] + brt * skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_BRT[o, d, out_period] + lrt * skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_LRT[o, d, out_period] + crl * skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_COMRAIL[o, d, out_period]

Name: WalkPrmTransitAvailable
Formula: (WalkPrmTotalIVT_out > 0 and WalkPrmTotalIVT_ret > 0) and skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_LOCAL[o, d, out_period] + skim.WLK_PRMTRN_WLK_LOCAL[d, o, in_period] == 0
